title: Separate joint-width constraints in T16 class realizations
body:
PR2169's class-level packing search can admit impossible pattern/flow marginals even with its full per-call Hall and optional single-width Gale-Ryser-style constraints. This package supplies an exact, standard-library separator for necessary cuts that consider a width subset and several calls together.

The source-bound strictness example uses its actual capacity-16 class 9: two nonempty bin patterns pass both existing constraint families but violate a joint cut with left side 4 and right side 3. Retiming one helper makes the same patterns legal. The new inequalities can therefore reject the impossible assignment while retaining patterns for different flows. The capacity-counting principle is standard and credited; the contribution is its concrete integration, strict gap and reusable separator for this pinned search.

The CLI accepts mindiff_cls1.py's actual stage1 schema and sorted-bin class numbering, emits exact violated inequalities, and states that passing is only a necessary-condition check. glob.py uses another class order and needs remapping. The proof explains how to add coefficients for all optimizer patterns, including absent sparse-candidate patterns. The already-reported eleven-quad-bin failure is treated only as a conditional calculation from reported aggregates: its c1 file was not retained. The source's pre-BAN 1002 relocation lower bound is neither invalidated nor certified here.

Validation on CPython 3.12.7: both registered commands pass. The selected and PR2169 concrete maps each supply 69,120 helpers over 32,256 bins and 144 classes, and pass all 182,652 prefix inequalities. Exhaustive 3-bin/3-call/two-width enumeration covers 19,683 concrete schedules, 2,995 distinct aggregates and 14,989 literal-subset comparisons, including 5,928 violating perturbations. Git-free optimized export, exact typed receipt, actual source corruption, public CLI, malformed marginal, exclusive-output and regeneration controls pass. A separate AI reviewer independently checked the proof/source/code, reran the optimized main replay and exercised the CLI on the strictness fixture without a blocker.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t16-joint-width-realization-cuts
```

Only this scoped package is added. Canonical main was fetched at start and submission and remains 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority 4. PR2169's exact current head 01b15aee27947d3319c8574464bdab80a00d2839 and six relevant snapshots are pinned; predecessor code is not executed. Main input bytes authenticate before structural reconstruction. This is not a fresh full native cold replay, a solver benchmark, a better owner map, an optimum, a supplier or a new kappa.

Overlap covers 729 open PR bodies with full REST pagination and a subsequent bounded recent-PR read. Discussions remain at the explicitly dated 1,197-record 12:29 UTC snapshot because GraphQL quota prevents refresh; live Curiosity Bot predecessor reading is not a complete board census. OVERLAP.json records coverage and the distinction from PR2363's concrete T74 exchanges. Open next questions concern optimizer benefit and remaining colored-realization obstructions.

Credit Philippe Van Velzen / PR2169 and its disclosed Claude assistance for the model, Hall/GR constraints, diagnosed failure, candidate and search artifacts; the retained seed67 auditor, selected construction, Douglas R. Colkitt and source lineage remain attributed. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI review. Apache-2.0. No hosted CI, human review or maintainer acceptance is claimed.
